week.name: Tuesday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 41.

nws_alerts.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued November 20 at 10:24AM MST until November 21 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow. Total snow accumulations between 12 and 24
inches, highest in the Upper Cottonwoods and near the Utah/Idaho
border.

* WHERE...The Wasatch Mountains.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Winter driving conditions are expected. Roads, and
especially bridges and overpasses, will likely become slick and
hazardous.

nws_alerts.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued November 20 at 1:25AM MST until November 21 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Pocatello ID
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow. Additional snow accumulations between 5 and 19
inches. Winds gusting as high as 45 mph.

* WHERE...Big Hole Mountains and Bear River Range.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult to impossible. Areas of
blowing snow could significantly reduce visibility. Gusty winds
could bring down tree branches.
